Loss of function is a plausible disease mechanism: SERPINC1 is LoF-intolerant (pLI=0.998, LOEUF=0.448 per gnomad_constraint), and PMID:34207366 describes this exact nonsense variant causing type-1 AT deficiency. VEP shows a canonical -1 splice-acceptor change (HIGH impact) that is c.2215-1G>C in the canonical OTOF long isoform ENST00000272371/NM_194248. SpliceAI predicts acceptor loss with DS_AL=0.989. aiva_evidence.PVS1: Canonical +1 splice donor variant in intron 10 of PMS2 (VEP splice_donor_variant, canonical transcript; SpliceAI DS_DL=0.988). Applied at Strong, not Very Strong, because the predicted product is an in-frame deletion rather than one degraded by NMD.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Very Strong (VCEP GN086 GCK PVS1 tree). Per VEP, this is a frameshift: ENST00000345378 c.1172del, p.Ile391ThrfsTer12. The new stop codon falls near codon 402, past the c.1198 NMD boundary, so the transcript is expected to escape NMD. The truncated protein would still lose the downstream sequence, including all of exon 10 and the critical α13 helix (p.444-456). GN086 applies Very Strong to stop codons in exon 10, and this more upstream truncation removes even more of the protein, so we extended that rule here. This is our interpretation; a strict SVI reading would give Strong.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Very Strong. Under the ACMG/ClinGen 2020 CNV standard, Section 2E (intragenic CNV) uses the PVS1 specifications, here those of ClinGen PAH VCEP GN006 v2.0. Per VEP, this 3,306 bp deletion (GRCh37 chr12:103,237,423-103,240,728) removes 286 coding nucleotides plus the exon 11 donor site. 286 is not a multiple of 3, so the reading frame is predicted to shift well upstream of c.1285. GN006 gives PVS1 Very Strong for frameshifts upstream of c.1285, which scores 0.90 points.

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Moderate. VEP calls this a canonical splice acceptor (-1) change. Per VCEP GN021, an acceptor -1/-2 change is predicted to skip the next exon downstream, which is exon 6. The VCEP marks its own blanket Strong/Moderate downgrades 'Not applicable'; reading that as permitting Strong via the decision tree is a judgement call.

SpliceAI predicts donor loss (DS_DL=0.996) at the native donor. The variant is at protein residue ~205, early in the 788-aa protein, so the result (exon skipping or a frameshift) is expected to trigger NMD. ITGB3 loss of function causes autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia (per the Verified Clinical Context; Thrombasthenia is listed among ITGB3 gene_diseases per PubTator).

Because Met1Leu may still allow some translation to start, applied at Moderate.

aiva_evidence.PS3: PMID:34572405 (Graça 2021) studied this variant in function assays. Translation can still start at the codon, but c.1A>T expression is very low. aiva_evidence.PVS1: Applied at Strong. Stop-gain (p.Arg306Ter on the e1 isoform, legacy p.R294X / c.880C>T on e2) in the last exon of MECP2, so the transcript is likely to escape NMD (per VEP).
